title: AI Promo Controller
tagline: Platform to find and control influencers using blockchain and AI
description:
AI Promo Controller is a platform that helps companies find influencers, send them tasks to promote their products and control the process through smart contracts and AI.

This project is built on OpenAI's multimodal model, which takes a screenshot of an influencer's completed task and checks if it fulfills the company's requirements.
how_its_made:
- Galadriel Devnet is used for smart contracts that handle all operations from creating requests to verifying task completion with an oracle that supports OpenAI multimodal model.
- ENS protocol is used for obtaining social data for influencer profiles.
- OpenAI is used as a multimodal LLM provider that verifies the fulfillment of tasks completed by influencer.
